description.value: Mission Leisure Centre is Mission's main municipal recreation facility, operated by the City of Mission, offering an aquatics pool, gym, skating rink, fitness programs, and youth sports clubs. As a full-service civic sports complex, it is a notable hub for community recreation in the Fraser Valley. Touring cyclists passing through Mission may find it a practical stop given the breadth of facilities typically associated with a facility of this type.
